one_liner_zh: Zscaler獲利超預期、營收逾8億美元，零信任資安需求穩健支撐成長。
one_liner_en: Zscaler beat on earnings with revenue topping $800M, supported by steady zero-trust security demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 1.01美元優於預估0.90美元，意外幅度12.56%。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正面：EPS超預期12.56%顯示獲利能力穩健，零信任資安結構性需求支撐營收。短期業績友善，但營收年增率缺失使成長動能判讀受限。中期關鍵在於計費收入、淨續約率與新產品交叉銷售。建議追蹤RPO、自由現金流利潤率與大型交易（如7位數ARR客戶）成長，評估其在競爭加劇下能否維持市占與定價力，並留意企業資安預算週期變化。
ai_view_en: Positive signal: a 12.56% EPS beat shows solid profitability, with structural zero-trust demand supporting revenue. Results are friendly near-term, but missing YoY revenue limits reading the growth trajectory. Mid-term hinges on billings, net retention, and cross-selling of newer products. Track RPO, FCF margin, and growth in large deals (e.g., seven-figure ARR customers) to assess whether it can hold share and pricing amid stiffer competition, and watch enterprise security budget cycles.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.01美元，優於預估0.90美元，意外幅度12.56%
營收8.158億美元，維持穩健訂閱成長
零信任架構普及帶動長期需求
獲利能力與營運效率持續改善
highlights_en: EPS of $1.01 beat the $0.90 estimate, a 12.56% surprise
Revenue of $815.8M with steady subscription growth
Profitability and operating efficiency continue to improve
risks_zh: 營收年增率未提供，成長斜率難精確評估
SASE市場競爭加劇，客戶取得成本上升
本益比未提供，估值對成長放緩敏感
risks_en: Revenue YoY not disclosed, making the growth slope hard to gauge precisely
Intensifying SASE competition raises customer acquisition costs
PE unavailable; valuation sensitive to any growth slowdown
